_about: Every public-domain Samuel Rutherford (1600?-1661) text the Word Hoard holds that is not already on the Andrew Bonar shelf. Bonar's editions of the Letters (Gutenberg 42557), the Quaint Sermons (1885) and the Fourteen Communion Sermons (1876) are held there, recorded here under _held and not refetched. CCEL ThML is fetched for both CCEL titles. Internet Archive OCR adds Lex, Rex (1843 reprint) and the major treatises, which survive on IA only in their first printings (1644-1655): raw, unconverted, and old-type OCR, so expect long-s errors. Not to be confused with the novelist S. R. (Samuel Rutherford) Crockett, whose many books share the name on IA.
